notify.glyphs: Could not read the glyph grids. Check the glyph file path in the widget settings.

glyphs_path.label: Glyph file
glyphs_path.description: Dot Clock grids (glyphs.txt), shared with the Dot Clock font.

pitch.label: Grid step
pitch.description: Distance between two dot centers in pixels; sets the clock size.

dot_scale.label: Dot size
dot_scale.description: Dot diameter relative to the grid step (1.0 makes dots touch).

char_gap.label: Character gap
char_gap.description: Empty grid cells between two characters.

show_date.label: Date
show_date.description: Show the date under the time in smaller dots.

blink_colon.label: Blinking colon
blink_colon.description: Hide the colon every other second.

colon_color.label: Separator color
colon_color.description: Color role of the colon and of the dots in the date; set it to error for a red accent.

date_align.label: Date position
date_align.description: Only with left alignment: 0 puts the date under the left edge of the time, 0.5 centers it, 1 aligns it to the right edge.

layout.label: Layout
layout.description: Horizontal shows HH:MM on one line; vertical stacks hours, minutes and seconds without colons.

align.label: Alignment
align.description: Aligns every line, time and date, on the left edge, the center or the right edge of the widest line.
